info.title: FigCraft Cloud document images API
info.description: The bytes of images that documents refer to by reference (large images do not travel inside collaboration batches). An image is addressed by the lower-case hex SHA-256 of its file. Callers prove themselves with the browser session cookie (same-origin fetch), a service-account bearer, or the room's own token in the X-Figcraft-Room-Token header (a share-link secret, or a realtime ticket for the minute it lives). Errors use the common envelope {error:{code,message,request_id}}; image failures add error.reason (image_too_large, unsupported_image, invalid_image, hash_mismatch, storage_quota).

put.summary: Store an image for a document, content-addressed in the caller's tenant.
put.description: The body is the image file (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, any Content-Type; the file is recognised by its content). It must hash to {sha256} and stay within the workspace's image size (FIGCRAFT_IMAGE_MAX_BYTES, 100 MiB by default; 413 above it, decided from Content-Length before the body is read) and pixel budgets. Identical bytes are stored once per tenant; the image is attached to the document so it is kept while the document exists. Needs document.edit (or an editor share link, or a service account with documents:write). At most 8 images move at once on a replica; the rest get 503 and retry.

200.description: The tenant already held these bytes; nothing was written.

400.description: Not a SHA-256 address, an empty body, bytes that do not hash to the address (reason hash_mismatch) or a file that is not a valid image within the pixel budgets (reason invalid_image).

403.description: The caller may view the document but not edit it.

404.description: No such document in the caller's tenant, or one the caller cannot see.

409.description: The document is archived or being deleted.

413.description: The image is over the size limit.

415.description: Not a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF.

503.description: Too many transfers in flight, or storage unavailable. Retry.

507.description: The tenant's image storage quota (FIGCRAFT_IMAGE_TENANT_QUOTA_BYTES) is used.

get.summary: Read an image that is attached to the document.
get.description: Needs document.join_realtime (anyone who can open the document). The response is the file with its media type, an ETag of the address and a one-year private immutable cache lifetime: the address names the content. An image the document does not hold reads as 404 even if the tenant holds the same bytes for another document.

404.description: No such document, or no such image in it.

503.description: Too many transfers in flight, or storage unavailable. Retry.

Sha256.name: sha256
Sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the image file.

RoomToken.name: X-Figcraft-Room-Token
RoomToken.description: The room's token (a share-link secret, or a realtime ticket) instead of a session cookie.
